dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Everything has its cause... And what cause brings you to Bantan Sango Detective Agency today?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about the Bantan Sango Detective Agency...

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: As the name suggests, it's a detective agency that helps people figure out the truth behind cases.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Be it murder, banditry, extramarital affair investigations, or pet searches... We can handle any trouble you may have, and I'm not making empty promises here.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Of course, the fees related to our services aren't going to be cheap. So it's best to have the payment ready before coming here.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Let me think. What else do I have to say... Oh, right. I also have a word of advice for you...

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Emotion is the enemy of truth, and conscience the burden of knowledge. If you aren't ready to handle the truth, do not cross the threshold of wisdom lightly.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: A family member lost in an attack by an unknown deity... What an interesting case. It's definitely a worthwhile case for our agency.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Hmm... You obtained some clues from meeting them? That makes things easier. Tell me what you know then.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: ...Hey, come closer. Best not to let anyone eavesdrop on critical information.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, are you going out to investigate?

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Well, gathering intelligence is Ryuuji's duty.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: ...Huh? Me? Slack off? No way! Hmph, I think you just don't get it!

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Analyzing clues is painstaking work. As the manager at the heart of everything, I just need to patiently wait for the incoming intelligence and analyze them.
